name: Neon Spines
description: Five blue slowing lanes carry narrow red lethal spines from top to bottom. A broad horizontal blue crossing surrounds two red bars and an open central pocket. Segmented cyan perimeter walls preserve the lane entrances. Four pink bouncers start at the upper-left spine, lower-left field and two lower-right positions; two cyan patrols begin along the top and upper-right rails. Start at bottom center, step sideways away from the red spine, and reveal 75%.
